description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/raw_april_notes.txt which contains messy, chronological parental notes for April 2026 with clear D0 damage signals (child becoming distant after criticism, hiding emotions) and D6 decline signals (refusing to practice voluntarily, saying 'no point', extrinsic/escape-driven motivation). (2) Create the file 2026-04-30-月度速记.md inside /workspace/projects/workspace/memory/xiyue/records/ following the exact skill format. (3) Include YAML frontmatter with the proprietary tag 喜悦/月度速记. (4) Apply the mandatory three-item monthly structure: ✅ 一个惊喜, ⚠️ 一个担心, 💎 一个内驱信号. (5) Correctly classify D0 as 🔴 (child hid emotions, became distant after criticism = D0 damage) and D6 as 🔴 (stopped initiating, escape-driven = D6 decline). (6) Invoke the forced stop mechanism - explicitly state that all 'improvement arrangements' should be paused, NOT escalated. (7) Directly answer the parent's question about adding training/tutoring with a counter-recommendation: when D0/D6 are red, do NOT add more training or tutoring classes. (8) Mention recovery priority order starting with 关系(D0). The key proprietary traps are: the exact three-item monthly structure (惊喜/担心/内驱), the signal light system with forced stop protocol, the counter-intuitive advice against adding more training when risk signals appear, and the specific tag format in frontmatter.
